question_typed: revenue per bulan, dan jumlah order per bulan
explanation: Aggregates revenue and distinct order counts per month derived from order_date.
code: SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS jumlah_order FROM read_csv_auto(?) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan
observation: Pertanyaan diketik manual (input kosong, placeholder 'What would you like to know?'). LLM menghasilkan SQL yang tepat: agregasi bulanan + distinct order_id (benar untuk B2B, 1 order = banyak baris). strftime pada order_date dengan format tanggal campuran - lihat hasil run.
